text: Acceptance 14 (edit): inline edit never closes. Repro (anna, own msg 29): ArrowUp, append text, Enter -> PATCH ok (body 'first (edited by me)', editedAt set) but .inline-edit stays; Escape -> still open; only switching conversation clears it. Cause: applyMessageUpdate -> upsertMessageNode returns early when the node holds .inline-edit (l.575); Escape -> renderMessages() restores the editor (zapiszOtwartaEdycje/odtworz..., l.480-505, 560). Fix: remove the editor before update/re-render.
